# BoolBul (https://boolbul.com)
> Lightweight in-app cancellation interceptor & exit telemetry engine for indie SaaS ($500 - $25k MRR).

## Overview
BoolBul intercepts churning SaaS users directly inside the application before they reach Stripe/Dodo billing portals. It evaluates dynamic exit pauses, discounts, and feedback surveys on Turso LibSQL Edge (<10ms globally) with a strict 1500ms fail-open SLA and 0% dark patterns.

## Core Capabilities
- In-app exit deflection modal (3 themes: Neo-Brutalist, Minimal Slate, Midnight OLED)
- Turso LibSQL Edge rules evaluation (<10ms)
- Dodo Payments & Stripe automated subscription pause & discount execution
- Tamper-proof HMAC-SHA256 & JWT token verification
- 100% FTC Click-to-Cancel (16 CFR Part 425) & California ARL compliance

## API & Client SDK
- Web Client Hook: `openRetentionModal({ publicKey, customerId, subscriptionId, onCancelConfirmed, onOfferAccepted })`
- Edge Config: `GET https://boolbul.com/api/v1/widget-config/[publicKey]` (Cloudflare CDN cached, s-maxage=3600)
- Edge Init: `POST https://boolbul.com/api/v1/intercept/init`
- Edge Claim: `POST https://boolbul.com/api/v1/intercept/claim`
- Webhook Ingest: `POST https://boolbul.com/api/webhooks/dodo`

## Full Developer Spec
Read https://boolbul.com/llms-full.txt for complete schemas, TypeScript interfaces, and integration prompts.
